In this work, we propose WebInject, a prompt injection attack that manipulates the webpage environment to induce a web agent to perform an attacker-specified action.
Multi-modal large language model (MLLM)-based web agents interact with webpage environments by generating actions based on screenshots of the webpages.
Our attack adds a perturbation to the raw pixel values of the rendered webpage.
